import json
import andes
import numpy as np
import os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

ssa = andes.load(
    andes.get_case("5bus/pjm5bus.json"),
    setup=False,
    no_output=True,
    log=False,
)

ssa.add(
    "PQ",
    param_dict={
        "bus": 3,
        "idx": "PQ_VERIFY_087_E",
        "p0": 0.016,
        "q0": 0.01,
    },
)

ssa.setup()

scale_factor = 1.05
ssa.PQ.set(src="p0", idx=ssa.PQ.idx.v, attr="v", value=scale_factor * ssa.PQ.p0.v)
ssa.PQ.set(src="q0", idx=ssa.PQ.idx.v, attr="v", value=scale_factor * ssa.PQ.q0.v)

ssa.PFlow.run()

bus_ids = np.asarray(ssa.Bus.idx.v, dtype=int)
bus_v = np.asarray(ssa.Bus.v.v, dtype=float)

plot_file = "scenario_087_turn3_voltage.png"

plt.plot(bus_ids, bus_v, marker="o")
plt.xlabel("Bus ID")
plt.ylabel("Voltage Magnitude (p.u.)")
plt.title("Bus Voltage Profile")
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(plot_file, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

result_json = {}
result_json["added_load_idx"] = "PQ_VERIFY_087_E"
